name: Enemy Posture System - POST05 selective reaction suppression (TEST)
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. POST05: on top of the POST03.1 observer and the POST04 posture core, an ordinary non-lethal sword hit that lands while an admitted E_OC Bokoblin is in ATTACK (states 0/1/2) and does not cross the posture threshold no longer starts the DAMAGE flinch: the final setActionMode(DAMAGE) of damage_check is undone by restoring the three mode fields to their pre-call values. HP, hit SE, hit-stop, cooldown and all other reactions (BIG_DAMAGE, death, Finish, threshold hit, other weapons, E_OC2) stay vanilla. One PRE+POST hook, PRE always continues. Replaces POST04/03.1/03/02/01: never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
